ruling: R39 (owner, 2026-11-13): the pilot's first monitored set, its five open repository-presenter issues
meaning: One recorded reproduction per monitored issue, taken verbatim from the issue body (its script, its setup steps, its 'Where in the repository' source locations). reproduces_if_any is the issue's own 'Actual result'; resolved_if_all / resolved_if_output_empty is its 'Expected'. Output matching neither is NOT_VERIFIABLE and is never closed. Only reviewed commits change this file.

evidence.detail: only the first 100 characters are examined
`content.includes('mtllib') || content.includes('usemtl') || content.match(/^v\s+-?\d/)` is the whole OBJ test
`decompose` stores `rotation[0] = { w, x, y, z };`, a plain object rather than a `Quaternion`
`save` maps the extensions `obj`, `stl`, `gltf`, `glb`, `dae` and `3mf` to a format; there is no `fbx` branch, and `:312-316` falls back to the OBJ format
the exporter is chosen from five format names; `FbxFormat` reaches `throw new Error("Unsupported format: ...")` at `:360`
`openFromBuffer` detects glTF, 3MF, COLLADA and OBJ and otherwise uses `StlImporter` (`:221`); there is no FBX branch
writes `tri[0] tri[1] tri[2]`, which are polygon indices from `Mesh.polygons`, as the vertex of the facet
writes the same indices as floats into the vertex slots of the binary record

writes the header, the count and each record as separate `stream.write(Buffer)` calls, and `src/aspose/threed/Scene.ts:325` handles each Buffer write for a file path with `fs.writeFileSync(path, data)`, which replaces the file, so only the last record remains
